scope: Bounded required-predicate inventory of requirements001–013 only. Numeric examples, corpus counts, helper-only dependencies and excluded inputs are not required outcomes. No frozen whole-product denominator. Broader automation-workflows owner is not adopted here.

contexts.owner-scope: Current owner input/scope exclusions apply: resolvable in-domain targets; no arbitrary dangling/wrong/cross-track targets; no >=3 coincident-event fixture or evaluator t<t0. Static document predicates are distinct from runtime lanes/host delivery.
contexts.E(t): Logic-side stored-event evaluator at explicit envelope time t>=t0 with supplied provider/converter/mode; not observed UI, playback song time or ramped output. Identity/Pan full-range and FP/library/object assumptions retained.
contexts.P(t): Ideal engine segment value at explicit envelope time, from point list: curved Float16 pieces, Float first time -1e7, mode1. Actual song offset, lane/Session state and ramped sample delivery remain conditional or U. Canonical mix A6 settings/segment-update conditions apply; actual parameters/settings are not established by an explicit helper call.

phase_order: Lexical/member reading -> root post-load discard -> survivor validation; curve member post-load context enabled. Do not apply survivor refusals to removed envelopes; do not treat discard as repairing prior text parse refusal.

route_definitions.X-route: Stated bounded computation has established retained original-function route; no claim every future branch vector was run or application reaches supplied state.
route_definitions.S-route: Stated qualified schema/static predicate or bounded reviewed source chain; no new execution/grade.
route_definitions.no-established-route: No established complete route at stated unknown/public/state boundary under ADR0003/current budget; partial X/helper evidence does not close it and this is not impossibility.

join_catalog.schema: Stated storage/type/order or permitted shape only; does not prove runtime lane/device/parameter binding or validation of every shape.
join_catalog.binding: Selected Id lookup/owner contract with resolvable same-document targets within owner exclusions; not actual loaded AFloatAutomationTarget/provider identity.
join_catalog.stored-units: Document units as declared/inferred by owner, not logic conversion or engine/ramped-output units. Volume/Send conversion qualification remains separate.
join_catalog.ordering: Selected searches use document order; absence of a discovered sorter is not exhaustive proof for malformed input.
join_catalog.id-load: Duplicate/missing item Id load behavior not traced; shipped uniqueness does not impose refusal/renumbering behavior.
join_catalog.save-id: A5 same-target save binding remains assumed; event/target Id preservation or renumbering and durable reopen transaction untraced.
join_catalog.missing: Constructor/unset member reading is static only; final load outcome for missing Time/Value remains owner U after removal/validation ordering.
join_catalog.writer: Selected member-writer/default predicate/formatter or inferred leading-copy rule only; actual public Save/target binding/roundtrip remains A5 and unknown transaction.
join_catalog.save-leading: Current-build always-write and differing-leading-value persistence not established by shipped writes or legacy leading-copy translator.
join_catalog.purge: Reviewed static root post-load removal before survivor walk. Preserve own-device target relation and unchanged application-start discard setting; target opt-outs prevent generalization.
join_catalog.open-after-purge: Reviewed bounded Pan input opens after discard under RA2 premises; not a whole-app runtime observation or arbitrary target proof.
join_catalog.evaluator: Established local Float E(t) supplied-event/provider route; identity/Pan full-range X, actual loaded owner/converter A1 and consumer-visible reading A2 remain qualified.
join_catalog.playback-points: Static ideal envelope-time P(t) point-list/lookup rule, Float first-time rewrite only. No actual song offset, active player, ramped sample or audio delivery credit.
join_catalog.unsorted: No exhaustive insert/sort/load path and no defined complete evaluator output for unsorted input; retains U.
join_catalog.validation: Root post-load removal precedes unconditional survivor checks; scoped target ownership/discard setting premises remain. This is source-derived refusal/pass predicate, not observed UI/error delivery.
join_catalog.timeline: AListAutomation check is no-op for timeline owner path; no-other-owner-check premise remains, owner post-load not fully read. No general Arrangement timeline behavior inferred.
join_catalog.presentation: Actual public refusal/error presentation and UI state are untraced; internal corrupt-document error is not that observable.
join_catalog.curve-storage: Local default/has-curve/segment-direction predicate on event controls; loaded owner/UI/playback delivery remains separate.
join_catalog.monotone: Existing self-contained M scalar route. Historical four pairs are not an exhaustive input set or proof every prospective branch vector was run; arm64-only fused placement remains qualified.
join_catalog.normalization: Live Set post-load context enabled statically (T11); surviving-event normalization/reset source path. Removal, own-device relation and unchanged discard gate stay explicit.
join_catalog.consumer-mode: Argument0/1 computes known local values; actual UI/LOM/other consumer-to-mode caller path not traced. No default mode invented.
join_catalog.reading: Actual caller/UI/LOM reading connected to logic E(t) is untraced; local returned value alone does not establish displayed/applied parameter value.
join_catalog.range: Loaded envelope owner/provider/converter/range A1 is unbound. Curve clamps supplied provider range; hold/linear/equal branches do not establish application clamping.
join_catalog.clip-time: Clip start/loop/warp to automation offset/provider time is untraced; retained value cases use track envelopes.
join_catalog.bezier: Established supplied-control scalar Bezier point computation only; 15 interior points are not a runtime polyline receiver, song clock or ramped audio.
join_catalog.song-time: Actual song beat minus automation offset, initial Arrangement/Session index, loaded provider/parameter and active player/clock joins remain unresolved (mix A3/A6/A8).
join_catalog.discrete: Local Bool/Enum evaluator/getters on supplied lists, no converter requested; actual consumer-mode and player/parameter delivery separate.
join_catalog.meter: Local discrete selection does not settle loaded Manual/meter precedence or actual transport meter effect; owner refers dependency U.
join_catalog.lexical: Dependency generic-member lexical/writer contract under A4 for Bool/Enum. Lexical rejection is reader-stage; removal-before-survivor-validation does not repair text already refused during parsing.
join_catalog.manual: Manual-versus-envelope source selection/initial lane state/drive not established for named parameter class; mix A8 remains conditional.
join_catalog.override: Override/re-enable flags have native landmarks but actual public manual-change, clear scope and persisted state behavior stay U.
join_catalog.record: No established automation-recording writer, timestamp/Id/step/leading-event and transaction join; document snapshots do not settle produced data.
join_catalog.undo: No established edit/history operation to envelope state and saved-result route.
join_catalog.lock: LockEnvelope stored values known; actual behavior/owner dispatch not traced.
join_catalog.transform: Stored transform representation known; evaluation/application/commit behavior untraced.
join_catalog.kind: No retained load/evaluation route for event class mismatching target kind; shipped/schema agreement does not define malformed input behavior. Owner U and fixture exclusion retained.

auxiliary_not_counted.source_observations: Shipped envelope/event/target counts, unique Id/NextPointeeId statistics, leading-value/count distributions and all4151 passing curves corroborate source facts only; not load obligations/outcome denominators.
auxiliary_not_counted.excluded_inputs: Dangling/wrong/cross-track target, evaluator before first event, >=3 coincident events and older migration remain exclusions, not required crash outcomes.
auxiliary_not_counted.loaded_provider_units: Owner +130 cast to IConversionAndInterpolatorProvider and target slot+8 explain conditional parameter converter: Pan identity; Volume/Send gain->fader position. Actual loaded owner binding remains mix A3.
auxiliary_not_counted.sample_delivery: P(t) differs from E(t) and from ramped samples. Settings/lane/index/clock/player/protocol/host joins stay open; actual ramped sample constraints remain owned by mix graph, not added here.

grades: All owner D/S/X/U, exclusions, withdrawn cases and release expectations unchanged.

floating_point_and_library_limits.linear: X2 x86_64 glibc fma reproduces the fused linear evaluator operation order; both-slice correspondence is static inference, not arm64 execution.
floating_point_and_library_limits.curve_and_M: Curve bisection and monotone predicate fuse operations on arm64 only; x86_64 uses separate multiply/add. The below1e-6 curve difference is inferred, not measured or a proof for every threshold input.
floating_point_and_library_limits.conversion: Full-range null-converter/Pan X stays valid. Every Float branch depends on conversion. Volume/Send parameter converters imply fader positions only under loaded-owner binding; no general exact gain roundtrip or stored-unit claim.
floating_point_and_library_limits.samples: Neither bit-exact E(t) nor ideal P(t) comparator grades a ramped sample. Current mix-r2 signed32 conversion/overflow and shortening rules outrank older T14 generic clamp prose.
